introduction: Explore the Tower of Darkness and Dubneth: the Bloodstone messenger and captain’s key, Katalia’s bindings, Amelia’s locket and Dorthan’s shield, the three planar keys of stasis, and the physically connected Star Stone and prisoner stories currently credited to Braddistock.
orientation: Active, ready accounting is mandatory for discovery, visible encounters, journals and new achievement/daily credit. Discovering the Tower of Darkness has its own achievement. Questions, reading, kills, current possession and attempted travel do not complete native exchanges.

The Tower source also includes Dubneth village, the farmhouse and church, planar side routes, loading rooms and Sargon’s prison. Follow exact source and destination identities; lore names alone do not define quest terminals.

Five physically local requests — Azlion, Jenifer, Father Darrin, Danthas and Isabia — currently belong to Braddistock by giver-number range. Their accepted recipes remain in that owning journal. Tower encounters do not discover Braddistock; the broader physical campaign is guidance until explicit cross-zone affiliation and discovery support is designed.

The oak entrance resets closed but unlocked in both directions; opening, rather than prior sergeant-key history, is the initial route requirement. The sergeant carries the matching key for later locked state. The Bloodstone letter yields a small note; the note or guarded 100-platinum bribe yields the captain key. Earlier receipts are optional route help, and key issuance is not unlocking, opening or passage.

Recover the hidden board’s steel key for Katalia, and use the priest’s different small black key for Amelia. Amelia’s locket and five exact swords yield Dorthan’s shield. Supplies received from another player remain valid without personal rescue/source history.

Speak the exact magic words at the actual locked exits: sargon for the cleric routes, darkfather for the upper-level diagonal door, and thothrontithos for the elemental route. Successful speech clears lock/secret state, while opening and surviving arrival remain separate. Asking a quest topic is a different interaction.

The illusion maze has actual direction-triggered teleport objects that can override ordinary room exits. Select the active room object and command, rather than trusting labels alone. The central portal reaches Janyon’s hall. The portal of darkness containing an elemental key is a container, not a teleporter.

Verinor’s Death key, the elemental container’s key and Gailon’s Creation key yield the statue’s stasis key. Bone, conquest and demon murals use distinct real teleporter destinations. Actual route use, traps, hidden recovery, current shared doors and perception require qualification.

Father Darrin’s five Star Stone pieces are declared on Kinslor, Mordren, the Cardinal, Earlion that Is and Urian. Their exchange yields the Star Key in the Braddistock journal. The Star Key fits the hill keystone and prison door; neither receipt proves surviving Sargon or ending the campaign.

The Cardinal’s bone key also opens a chest with a thirty-percent hammer child. Isabia consumes that key and yields a ring; Danthas consumes the ring for leggings. Access keys and delivered proof need distinct physical allocation. Isabia’s D0 departure remains narrative only.

Danthas and other mobile actors can start in loading/holding rooms. Some routes enter a room with no outward exit; actual roaming, population, admitted generation and perception need qualification before reliable daily supply. Reset mode zero keeps disappearing recipients story-only.

The bounded active-world scan finds an outward route to Troll Hills 1883 but no ordinary incoming exit or foreign fixed ITEM_TELEPORT into this room range. This is an access concern to qualify with builders and other travel mechanisms before proposing a topology change.

Fenrral’s one village tavern shop sells food and drinks; this is not rental or a story outcome. Hammer proc placeholders, copied item/shop descriptions, holding-room placement and narrated-but-unimplemented departures remain separate pending proposals. No unsupported event credit or fee bypass is introduced.

Azlion and Father Darrin retire on acceptance in physical Tower reset mode zero, but their current Braddistock owner has reset mode two, making the static catalog mark them repeatable/potential daily. This is not proven physical renewal: qualify actual actor episodes and supply independently of immutable receipt owner before daily use.

contacts.name: Katalia
contacts.description: Katalia starts at kitchen 134016. The steel-key exchange gives experience and a darkfather clue; D0 supplies no retirement, escort or persistent rescue state.

contacts.name: an orc sergeant
contacts.description: The sergeant starts in 134015 with the equipped entrance key and accepts a Bloodstone letter for a separate small note and experience. Both entrance directions reset closed but unlocked; the equipped key is not mandatory initial-entry history.

contacts.name: an elite stone giant
contacts.description: Two elite stone giants are declared at 134022. Note and guarded cash routes yield the same captain key. Cash retires the selected instance, not both actors or a shared barrier.

contacts.name: Dorthan, the smith
contacts.description: Dorthan starts in village smithy 134065. He describes his daughter’s plight and accepts five exact swords plus her locket for a shield. Item proof does not force personal rescue history.

contacts.name: Amelia
contacts.description: Amelia starts in shrine 134028 alongside the priest. Her small-black-key exchange yields a locket and retires her instance; homecoming and reunion are not recorded.

contacts.name: a statue of an old man
contacts.description: The statue of Earlion starts at 134049 and accepts three different route keys for the stasis key. It is not the living Earlion in 134046. Both sides of the stasis door reset locked, with different native pickability.

contacts.name: Janyon, the old servant
contacts.description: Janyon starts in 134117 and says the master and Earlion hold old door keys. Asking aliases records no learned-topic objective.

contacts.name: Azlion the planetar
contacts.description: Azlion starts imprisoned in the circle at 134112. His staff exchange gives Redemption of Light and retires him. It currently belongs to the Braddistock journal by giver range; the narrated rift is not an actual new portal.

contacts.name: Jenifer
contacts.description: Jenifer starts at farmhouse 134127. Joseph’s exact head yields experience. This physically local request currently credits Braddistock, and accepts supplied proof without your own kill.

contacts.name: Father Darrin
contacts.description: Father Darrin starts in church 134138. Five different Star Stone pieces yield the Star Key and retire him. His request currently credits Braddistock; sacrifice narration does not establish Sargon’s defeat.

contacts.name: Danthas, the elven scout
contacts.description: Danthas is declared in loading room 134140, with outward routes toward distribution room 134141 and dead-end holding 134120. Qualify actual roaming and visible encounter. His ring-for-leggings request currently credits Braddistock.

contacts.name: Isabia, the elven noble
contacts.description: Isabia starts in prison 134042. The bone-key exchange yields her ring but D0 does not retire her despite departure narration. Her request currently credits Braddistock; supply and prison access remain separate.

contacts.name: an ogre mercenary
contacts.description: The ogre starts in tower foyer 134010 carrying Joseph’s exact head. Its _spec1_ tag selects a class specialization; it is not a custom Joseph-rescue handler.

contacts.name: a consecrated priest of Sargon
contacts.description: The priest starts in 134028 carrying Amelia’s small black key, which also opens the trapped desk. The key is a different kind from the captain’s or prison key.

contacts.name: a cloaked traveller
contacts.description: The cloaked traveller starts on the road at 134063 carrying the Bloodstone letter. His non-sentinel movement requires live source/perception qualification.

contacts.name: Cardinal Faethron
contacts.description: The Cardinal of Sargon starts in chamber 134039 carrying the bone key and one Star Stone piece. The bone key is spent by Isabia’s request and also used by a locked chest; key use and delivery need separate allocation.

contacts.name: DeadLord Verinor
contacts.description: Verinor starts in the palace of bones at 134072 carrying the key of Death. Combat, original recovery and accepted statue delivery are separate facts.

contacts.name: Gailon Darkhoast
contacts.description: Gailon Darkhoast starts at ritual room 134116 carrying the key of Creation and equipped with the charred access key. Ritual imagery adds no timed campaign endpoint.

contacts.name: Kinslor Elfslayer
contacts.description: Kinslor starts in the captain’s personal room 134018 carrying the first Star Stone piece. Receiving this piece is distinct from personally defeating him.

contacts.name: Lord Mordren Ap'Dethyin
contacts.description: Mordren starts in private chamber 134029 carrying a second Star Stone piece. This actor differs from ordinary priests and guards.

contacts.name: Earlion that is
contacts.description: Earlion that Is starts in 134046 carrying a Star Stone piece and the audience key. Earlion that Was and Will Be are distinct reset followers, not verified sequential transformations.

contacts.name: Urian Shadowborn
contacts.description: Urian starts in audience chamber 134122 carrying the fifth Star Stone piece and treasury key. His defeat is not a native campaign completion receipt.

contacts.name: Earlion that was
contacts.description: Earlion that Was follows the present Earlion from 134046. Time-fracture narration does not establish a separate recorded transformation stage.

contacts.name: Earlion, the ultraloth
contacts.description: Earlion that Will Be follows the present Earlion from 134046. Defeating all three is separate from the statue’s accepted three-key exchange.

contacts.name: a dark hearted warrior
contacts.description: The dark-hearted black guard starts at 134033 carrying key 134027 for the Master’s-area door. The reverse door has a different reset state; do not invent a universal historical access requirement.

contacts.name: Sargon, Demi-God of Shadows
contacts.description: Sargon is declared in interdimensional prison 134133. The Star Key’s door/keystone use, exile rift and return route need actual access and surviving-arrival qualification; no accepted native defeat endpoint is declared.

contacts.name: an excited conjurer
contacts.description: The excited conjurer starts in 134114 with Azlion’s cold-iron staff equipped in slot 18. Carry the exact staff loose for Azlion’s separately owned exchange; obtaining it does not record releasing the circle.

stories.title: Katalia’s binding key
stories.summary: Katalia, declared in the kitchen at 134016, accepts the steel key for 500000 experience and reveals darkfather. Her response describes freeing her but D0 does not remove or escort her. The password opens a separate magic-lock route only when actually spoken and accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 × a strong iron gate key
steps.hint: The sergeant in 134015 has the entrance oak key equipped in slot 18. Both entrance directions reset closed but unlocked, so this key is not a required initial-entry prerequisite. It can unlock a later locked door; current state and actual opening remain separate. Carry the exact kind loose. Supplied matching material fits; possession does not prove personal combat, first recovery, source, unlocking or arrival.

The steel key is P-declared inside the hidden key board 134037 at 134043. The board also contains a different prison key. Search, container access and recovery need actual qualification. Carry the exact kind loose. Supplied matching material fits; possession does not prove personal combat, first recovery, source, unlocking or arrival.

The giant accepts the note separately; neither receipt proves an emissary’s identity or entering the captain’s quarters.

stories.summary: Amelia and the priest are declared together at shrine 134028. Amelia accepts the small black key, gives her mother’s gold locket and retires through D1. Taking the locket to Dorthan is another exchange. This receipt does not prove an escort home or a reunion.

stories.title: Dorthan’s shield of Dubneth
stories.summary: Dorthan at the village smithy 134065 wants five black-iron two-handed swords and Amelia’s gold locket for one black-iron shield. The locket is narrative proof of safety; current acceptance needs the exact item and does not require your own rescue receipt. Five swords are five separate physical roots in one complete bundle, not five quests.

steps.hint: Amelia’s accepted small-black-key exchange yields the locket and retires her recipient instance. This is route guidance, not a required earlier receipt. A supplied exact offering remains valid.

Only Amelia’s native exchange produces this gold locket in the bounded active-source scan. Receiving a matching locket from another player remains valid. Carry the exact kind loose. Supplied matching material fits; possession does not prove personal combat, first recovery, source, unlocking or arrival.

stories.title: The three keys of stasis
stories.summary: The statue of Earlion at 134049 accepts the keys of Death, Elemental Magic and Creation together for key 134117 to the stasis chamber. They come from three separate routes. Issuing this key does not record visiting the chamber, defeating past/present/future Earlion, or completing Father Darrin’s five-piece Star Stone campaign.
